note: _cum diaconibus_ (Clementina) or _cum diaconis_ (Weber/Gryson, NVg)? – with the deacons. The correct form would be _cum diaconis_, but forms such as _diaconibus_ (as dative plural of _diaconus_) are attested in the Vulgate, see Plater/White, p. 65; cf. the reference to similar forms in Albert Blaise: _Manuel du Latin chrétien_. Strasbourg 1955 (221 pp.), p. 68. Kaulen, p. 120, suggests _diaco_, genitive: _diaconis_; similarly, Olegario García de la Fuente: _Latín bíblico y latín critiano_. Madrid 1994 (588 pp.), p. 291: _diacon_, _diaconis_.
